run_actor_critic_training: run the actor-critic RL training loop to optimize LLVM compiler pass sequences for a benchmark
create_policy_network: create a PyTorch Policy network with actor and critic heads for compiler pass selection
build_history_observation_wrapper: build a Gym ObservationWrapper that tracks action history as one-hot vectors for fixed-length episodes
run_select_action: run the select_action function to sample a compiler pass from the policy with optional exploration
run_finish_episode: run finish_episode to compute actor-critic losses and perform backpropagation after an episode completes
